policy: Freeze before official nonlearned score/performance collection. Original English finite developer diagnostics only: 48 parents, 12 prototypes, one author; connected groups are audited, not presumed. Known answerable checks stop at the first acceptable member; known no-answer checks exhaust every candidate including oracle; unknowns remain in original denominator but are excluded from utility/Top1/Top3. Top1/Top3 denominator is answerable requests; all candidates retained. Choose the strongest baseline on known-including-no-answer total checks with fixed declared kind order for ties; publish answerable-only oracle gap separately. Group failure does not permit fitting, splitting or reducing minimum15; unpartitioned nonlearned diagnostics may still be reported. No training roles, fitting, GPU, encoder, teacher, paid/model calls, protected-final reads, default activation or weight publication. Exact malformed/unknown-schema inputs return fixed errors; only valid out-of-rule-scope inputs use declared BM25 fallback (refinement of preparation-only fallback proposal). Runtime source manifest must match; source-only natural-language review is limited evidence. Performance: CPU scheduling GOMAXPROCS=1, 15-second child deadline, 60-second replay budget, each baseline three cold processes plus one warm process; five-stage warm timings have 20 warmups, 101 allocation probes and 2000 real-work samples per stage. One separate narrow-rule profiled replay with10000 repetitions is excluded from headline latency/RSS; only profile function aggregates may be public. No result cache. OS process RSS and GoHeapAlloc are separate. New data/numeric records budget64MiB, no new model artifacts. Performance targets are targets, not measured claims.
